[NDBG.2.3] **Rules:** `ds_engine_rule_meta_count` / `_at` / `_find` return a
`ds_rule_meta_view_t` per rule — name, cooldown window, source location, and the debug-name template (`RuleDebugName`). A
debugger uses these to label terminals and present per-rule rate-control state.
A rule's source file is `NULL` when no `DsSource` atom carries its module. `_find`
reports a miss through its found flag with `DS_OK` and does not write the view,
so the caller must read the view only when the flag is set.
